about_me.bio: I am a second-year Computer Science undergraduate at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) with a passion for building complex, interactive software systems. From crafting full-stack web applications to tinkering with game frameworks and game physics, I love breaking down complex architectures into clean, modular code. Beyond engineering, I train as a hybrid athlete, balancing high-performance weightlifting with competitive long-distance running.

hobbies.name: Running
hobbies.description: Dedicated long-distance marathoner and inter-hall road relay runner. Completed the 台灣國際馬拉松in台南 (Taiwan International Marathon) with a net time of 3:34:19.

hobbies.description: Interested in technical systems tinkering, game mechanics exploration, and scripting with Minecraft command blocks.

hobbies.name: Speedcubing
hobbies.description: Competitive speedcuber capable of sub-10 second 3x3 solves, with a personal best single of 4.80 seconds featuring a last-layer skip.

projects.name: Astertris
projects.short_description: A space-themed Tetris variant implementing complex radial gravity mechanics.
projects.description: Designed and engineered a standalone desktop Tetris variant where blocks fall toward a central gravity point instead of downwards. Implemented precise collision fields, custom radial rotation math, and physics optimization.

projects.name: CellCollab
projects.short_description: A real-time multiplayer sandbox environment powered by WebSockets.
projects.description: Architected a highly responsive web sandbox using React.js and standard WebSockets to support seamless multi-user state synchronization. Solved complex challenges related to event ordering, state conflict, and latency minimization.

projects.name: Pawsport & Peer
projects.short_description: A pet care coordination platform for distributed responsibilities.
projects.description: Led the software engineering architecture for a pet management application, conducting full requirements analysis, drawing meticulous UML schemas, and laying out modular UI components for cooperative pet tracking.
